description: The Australian Maritime Safety Authority publishes monthly vessel traffic data extracted from its Craft Tracking System (CTS), the agency's vessel traffic database, on its Spatial@AMSA site. CTS collects vessel traffic data from several sources, including terrestrial and satellite AIS. Each monthly dataset covers the extent of Australia's Search and Rescue Region, and separate sub-area datasets of higher density cover Bass Strait, the Great Australian Bight and the North West. On 2026-09-29 the page listed files by year and month from 1999 to August 2026. Coverage: Australia's search and rescue region. Format and access: monthly downloads without registration; the file format is not stated on the listing. Licence and cost: free; no licence is stated on the download page. Caveats: satellite AIS coverage and sampling vary, and earlier years rest on fewer sources. It supports traffic flow, exposure and emergency response studies of Australian ports and sea lanes. It relates to Marine Cadastre AIS, the Norwegian Kystdatahuset and the Ushant AIS trajectories in the catalogue.
